Thai Queen Flies Gripen Fighter Jet Solo, Makes History

Thailand's Queen Suthida has made history by completing her first solo flight in a Gripen fighter jet. The Thai Royal Household confirmed the flight, which marks her as the first female monarch to pilot a fighter jet solo.
